title: Decimal numeric XML entities are not decoded
reasoning: The regex alternative for decimal numeric entities is written as #\\d+ inside a regex literal, so it does not match standard entities like   or '. The decimal decoding branch is therefore skipped for normal decimal entities, leaving raw entity text in labels, descriptions, rooms, instructor names, and other regex-parsed fields.
reproduction: parseCourseDetailXml on a description such as <description>A B</description> returns 'A B' instead of decoding the numeric entity.
recommendation: Change the decimal alternative to #\d+ in the regex literal and keep the existing parseInt branch. Consider adding invalid-codepoint handling if malformed entities are possible.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing entity test covers named entities such as & and <, but it does not cover decimal numeric entities.
suggestedRegressionTest: Extend the entity decoding test with decimal numeric entities, for example expecting ''' to decode to an apostrophe and ' ' to decode to a non-breaking space or normalized expected character.
minimumFixScope: apps/api/src/cisapi/parser.ts decodeXmlText regex plus one entity decoding assertion.
